description: First guess at a balanced mix, by root category (needs only Gate 1). Weights read as percent. The mix is NOT the natural one: recruitment is templated and repetitive, so it is held down; game talk (terms, the weakest eval metric), questions and coordination are lifted; greetings are formulaic and saturate quickly. Spam is a small share on purpose (recruitment walls are kept). Tune once there is data: preprocess prints which category limits the dataset.
